NEW DELHI: Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta on Saturday said the garbage mountains at the city's landfill sites were steadily shrinking as she reviewed waste disposal work at Okhla and laid the foundation stone for new waste processing facilities at Okhla, Ghazipur and Singhola.Gupta said the Delhi government had reclaimed 100 acres of land across the city's three landfill sites over the past one-and-a-half years, with a large portion of the cleared area also being turned green.She said almost all legacy waste at Okhla that existed before January 2025 had been processed."Today, at Okhla, we have processed almost all the legacy waste that was there before January 2025," Gupta said.Gupta said the government was working on two fronts: clearing the existing garbage mountains while ensuring that fresh waste generated every day did not accumulate into new landfill sites.According to news agency ANI, she said around 3,000-4,000 metric tonnes of fresh waste reaches the sites daily and is being processed round the clock."The garbage currently piled up here is essentially fresh waste generated after January 2025, and that too is being processed round the clock. So, we are fighting on two fronts: one is eliminating waste, and the other is ensuring that the 3,000 to 4,000 metric tons of fresh waste arriving daily is processed immediately, so that new garbage mountains are not formed for future generations," Gupta said.She said the government was working to reduce the existing garbage mountains to zero."People are seeing that the garbage mountains are continuously shrinking and soon a time will come when they will become zero," Gupta said.Gupta also said she had taken what she described as her "last selfie" with the garbage mountain at Okhla."Today I have taken my last selfie with the garbage mountain; after this I have taken a pledge that this garbage mountain will end soon," she said.Taking a jibe at the Opposition, Gupta added, "I had said - garbage mountain, you will have to go; the opposition mocked. Today I will say the garbage mountain is going; now only its back remains."During the programme at the Okhla SLF site, Gupta laid the foundation stone for fresh waste processing plants at Okhla, Ghazipur and Singhola, as well as a biogas facility at Ghazipur. She also inaugurated the M&CW Centre at Kotla Mubarakpur through virtual mode from Okhla.The Okhla plant will be built at a cost of Rs 103 crore and will have a processing capacity of 1,400 metric tonnes per day.The Singhola facility will cost Rs 42 crore and have a capacity of 800 metric tonnes per day, while the Ghazipur plant will have a processing capacity of 700 metric tonnes per day.The facilities are intended to process fresh waste as well as construction and demolition waste. Gupta said the new units would also produce biogas, green energy and manure."Waste should not remain waste; Delhi should use it as wealth," she said, adding that new technologies were being introduced for waste segregation and processing.She said waste and cattle dung would be used to produce biogas and manure as part of efforts to build a technology-driven waste management system.Gupta said the government was taking up several measures to address pollution, including work on landfill waste, cleaning the Yamuna, dust mitigation, plantation, road infrastructure and waste management."Our government is tackling pollution from a 360-degree perspective to ensure it gradually decreases. We are working on every aspect, be it addressing the mountains of garbage, cleaning the Yamuna, improving road infrastructure, or managing waste, to ensure the people of Delhi enjoy better air quality. Our resolve and policies are absolutely clear, and we are working 24x7 in the public interest," she said.The chief minister also reviewed the progress of waste disposal work with officials and directed them to accelerate the work according to the stipulated timeline.She said the garbage mountains at Bhalswa, Ghazipur and Okhla had caused inconvenience to people travelling through these areas and said the government was continuing efforts to eliminate them.
Article Summary: Gupta said the Delhi government had reclaimed 100 acres of land across the city's three landfill sites over the past one-and-a-half years. She said almost all legacy waste at Okhla that existed before January 2025 had been processed. Gupta said the new units would also produce biogas, green energy and manure.

Article Title: India-US trade talks hit ‘plateau’: Sitharaman says further give-and-take ‘very, very difficult’
Article Text:
Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman

India stresses strategic autonomy in trade negotiations

India-EU pact opens market access

India and US have reached a “plateau” in negotiations over their bilateral trade agreement, with further concessions from either side likely to be "very very difficult", finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman said on Monday. Speaking at the Munich Leaders Meeting in New Delhi, she said that while negotiations are still underway, any progress from here would depend on whether there was limited room for compromise on either side.“The agreement negotiations are still ongoing, although we'd like to believe that both the sides have reached a plateau beyond which giving or taking might be very, very difficult. But maybe if there are rooms to operate from, both sides would do it,” Sitharaman said.She said the agreement was still being “hard and very rigorously negotiated” and that India has a trade surplus with the US. “But what is the predominant feature of the trade relations between India and the US? The trade balance is very much in our favor.”Sitharaman said that the US would naturally want to reduce this trade imbalance and address what it sees as losses built up over the years.She also said that the way countries negotiate trade deals was changing, with governments now looking beyond traditional negotiations to address trade imbalances.“Negotiation used to be the only platform through which countries could highlight the discrepancies, highlight the lop-sidedness and say, would we want to correct this?” she said.“Tariff was an instrument of negotiation, and tariff had a certain framework within which you will apply it. Today framework is there, tariffs are going,” she said, while stressing that countries still need to negotiate and find “some give and take”.Sitharaman was also asked about maintaining strategic autonomy while negotiating bilateral trade agreements with European countries, including in the context of India procuring Russian oil."There is no Lindsay Graham Bill in Europe...," she said.On the broader question of how bilateral trade agreements can protect a country's interests in an era of multilateralism, Sitharaman said countries were increasingly choosing bilateral partnerships where they saw greater benefit.“Countries choose where multilateralism would benefit them, and there are some unique bilaterals which countries choose to have. The balance is somewhat tilted in favour of the bilateral rather than the multilateral,” she said.She said countries were now increasingly looking for new trade partners and strengthening those relationships through agreements.“Countries are now rapidly catching up with — I would put the EU-India also in a bilateral mode -because it's one in the name of union, but of course within them they have. So, bilaterals today are catching up far more than even initiating or beginning a multilateral. It's not deliberate, but in a way, if you don't do it, you're not moving forward. Countries will have to choose new partners for their trade and strengthen the tie through an agreement. And therefore, newer partnerships are being searched for, and they are tied up bilaterally.”FM Sitharaman cited the India-EU trade agreement as a major example of India's approach to negotiating trade pacts while protecting domestic interests.She said India had opened 92.5 per cent of its tariff lines and around 97 per cent of tariff value under the agreement. The EU, meanwhile, had opened 99 per cent in value terms and possibly 97 per cent of tariff lines.According to Sitharaman, greater access to the European market could support employment in labour-intensive sectors, including footwear, textiles, toys and processed products. Many of these sectors are linked to micro and small enterprises.“Those are all in the micro and small medium industry segment, which are labor-intensive,” Sitharaman said, adding that greater access to the European market could generate “more exports, more jobs”.Sitharaman said bilateral trade agreements were becoming increasingly important as multilateral institutions have weakened.“Multilateralism is not going to go away. But multilateralism has weakened,” she said.She also stressed that multilateralism should continue even as countries increasingly pursue bilateral agreements.“Multilateralism is not going to go away and multilateralism shouldn't go away,” Sitharaman said.The Munich Leaders Meeting, being held in the National Capital, provides a platform for about 100 senior decision-makers and experts to discuss opportunities for stronger cooperation among emerging and middle powers amid profound geopolitical change. Discussions include geoeconomic developments, trade and connectivity, maritime security, defence cooperation and other key international challenges.
Article Summary: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman says India and US have reached a 'plateau' in negotiations over their bilateral trade agreement. She said any progress from here would depend on whether there was limited room for compromise on either side. She also said the way countries negotiate trade deals was changing, with governments now looking beyond traditional negotiations to address trade imbalances.

Article Title: Jio IPO sees bumper demand: India's largest public issue fully subscribed in just 100 minutes of opening
Article Text:
The IPO is open to retail investors, employees and eligible Reliance shareholders.

Jio IPO

Jio IPO: Jio Platforms' $3.2 billion initial public offering (IPO) was fully subscribed within less than two hours of bidding opening on Wednesday, as investors rushed to participate in India's biggest-ever share sale. The offering is also the first IPO from billionaire Mukesh Ambani 's Reliance group in two decades.According to a PTI report, the Jio IPO was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of its opening on October 21.The rapid subscription was notable because large IPOs in India often see a slow start, with institutional investors typically placing their bids closer to the closing deadline. By comparison, the National Stock Exchange of India's share sale recently attracted subscriptions for just 42% of the shares on offer on its first day. Hyundai Motor India's IPO had received bids for only 18% of its offering on the opening day.Also Read | Jio IPO, India’s largest public issue, opens for subscription: Price band, GMP to brokerage views - top 10 things to know The IPO is open to retail investors, employees and eligible Reliance shareholders. The issue will close on Friday, with shares priced in a band of Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 apiece.Exchange data showed that institutional investors had bid for 3.25 times the shares reserved for them by Wednesday. Retail participation was lower at that stage, with individual investors applying for 0.22 times their reserved quota.Retail investors have been allocated around one-third of the total offering.The IPO values Jio Platforms at as much as $108.3 billion. Once trading begins on October 28, the company could rank among India's largest listed companies by market capitalisation.Earlier this week, Jio Platforms allotted shares worth $853 million to domestic and international investors, including the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and BlackRock. The anchor investor portion attracted bids exceeding $25 billion, according to a Reuters report.Backed by global investors such as Meta, Google's parent company Alphabet and other institutional investors, Jio Platforms houses India's largest telecom operator. With more than 500 million subscribers, the business is the world's second-largest telecom operator within a single country, behind China Mobile.This is Reliance's first IPO since 2006. Jio Platforms' telecom business, led by Ambani's son Akash, began operations in 2016. Its strategy was built around the expectation that Indians would use the internet much more extensively if access became almost free. By offering inexpensive data and free voice calls, Jio quickly gained market share from competitors such as Bharti Airtel and Vodafone Idea.
Article Summary: Jio IPO was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of its opening on October 21. The rapid subscription was notable because large IPOs in India often see a slow start. The IPO is open to retail investors, employees and eligible Reliance shareholders. The issue will close on Friday, with shares priced in a band of Rs 1,065 to Rs1,119 apiece.

Article Title: LPG consumption down, diesel & petrol sales up in September
Article Text:
LPG consumption in Sept was recorded at 2.6 million tonnes (MT), compared to 2.9 MT during the same month a year earlier

NEW DELHI: LPG demand fell by over 9% year-on-year in Sept, while petrol and diesel sales registered growth of 7% and 5%, respectively, provisional data released by the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (PPAC) showed.LPG consumption in Sept was recorded at 2.6 million tonnes (MT), compared to 2.9 MT during the same month a year earlier.Month-on-month consumption, however, registered a growth of 8%, up from 2.4 MT.Petrol sales increased from 3.4 MT in Sept last year to 3.6 MT, while diesel consumption rose from 6.8 MT to 7.1 MT. Petrol and diesel consumption had registered year-on-year growth of 7.9% and 6.5%, respectively, in July.While petrol is largely used as an automobile fuel and its consumption is commensurate with the increasing number of vehicles, diesel is consumed by transport vehicles for passenger and freight movement, besides being used in the agricultural sector.Erratic monsoon conditions due to El Nino boosted demand for diesel for irrigation.Cumulative petrol consumption during Apr-Sept in the current financial year increased 7% to 22.6 MT, while diesel consumption rose 4.8% to 47.9 MT. In contrast, LPG consumption declined 14.9% to 13.8 MT from 16.2 MT during the corresponding period of 2025-26.
Article Summary: LPG consumption in Sept was recorded at 2.6 million tonnes (MT), compared to 2.9 MT during the same month a year earlier. Petrol sales increased from 3.4 MT in Sept last year to 3.6 MT, while diesel consumption rose from 6.8 MT to 7.1 MT.

Article Title: Bengaluru woman deposits Rs 4L in FD with cooperative society, gets back Rs 3L after maturity but is made to wait for remaining amount, consumer commission orders society to pay Rs 1.12L with 12% inte
Article Text:
Society had returned Rs 3 lakh of her Rs 4 lakh deposits but failed to pay balance despite repeated requests; consumer commission awards Rs 30,000 compensation and legal costs (AI image)​

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines





BENGALURU: The Bengaluru Urban District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission has directed Sree Thyagarajanagara Credit Co-operative Society to refund Rs 1,12,304 to a woman towards her outstanding fixed deposit amount, along with 12% annual interest from February 4, 2023, until realisation.The commission also ordered the society to pay Rs 20,000 as compensation for deficiency in service and Rs 10,000 towards litigation expenses. It has been given 45 days to comply with the order.The complaint was filed by K P Vanajakshi, a resident of Banashankari II Stage, who had deposited a total of Rs 4 lakh in five fixed deposit accounts with the cooperative society.According to the complaint, Vanajakshi became a member of the society on November 19, 2016, and purchased 50 shares of Rs 100 each. Her husband was also a member of the society.She had deposited Rs 50,000 each in two fixed deposit accounts and Rs 1 lakh each in three other accounts, taking the total investment to Rs 4 lakh.After the deposits matured, the society transferred the amounts to her savings bank account instead of directly paying her. Despite repeated requests for repayment along with the agreed interest, the society paid only Rs 1 lakh on February 4, 2023, and another Rs 2 lakh on April 3, 2024.The remaining amount was not paid. Vanajakshi's husband also made several representations to the society and approached the Deputy Registrar of Cooperative Societies in Bengaluru on September 30, 2024.The complainant subsequently sent another representation through registered post on May 28, 2025, seeking withdrawal of the outstanding amount, but the society failed to comply.In its defence, the society admitted that Vanajakshi had deposited Rs 4 lakh in five fixed deposit accounts and that it had repaid Rs 3 lakh. It also acknowledged that Rs 1,12,304, including the applicable interest, remained payable.However, the society cited a financial crisis and shortage of funds, claiming that several members who had borrowed money from it had defaulted on loan repayments. It said the defaults had affected its financial stability and left it unable to return the remaining deposit amount.The society also argued that the complainant had earlier approached the Deputy Registrar of Cooperative Societies over the same issue.After examining the documents and submissions, the commission observed that the society had admitted both the fixed deposits and its liability to repay the outstanding amount. It noted that the society had accepted the deposits and was obligated to honour the terms and conditions after their maturity.The commission held that the society's failure to repay the entire matured deposit amount, despite making partial payments and acknowledging the outstanding liability, amounted to deficiency in service.It observed that the society could not escape its responsibility to return the depositor's money by citing its own financial difficulties arising from loan defaults by other members.Allowing the complaint in part, the commission directed the society to pay Rs 1,12,304 with 12% annual interest from February 4, 2023, until realisation, along with Rs 20,000 compensation and Rs 10,000 litigation costs.The order was passed on October 17, 2026, by commission president Ramachandra M S and members Nandini H Kumbhar and Savitha Airani.
Article Summary: K P Vanajakshi had deposited Rs 4 lakh in five fixed deposit accounts with the cooperative society. Society had returned Rs 3 lakh of the deposits but failed to pay balance despite repeated requests. Sree Thyagarajanagara Credit Co- operative Society has been ordered to refund Rs 1,12,304.

Article Title: Microsoft asked him to go back to India after his H-1B visa was rejected. Kunal Bahl returned, but to build Snapdeal, Titan Capital
Article Text:
Kunal Bahl recalls his H-1B visa rejection story.

Microsoft asked Kunal Bahl to move to India after H-1B rejection

How H-1B rejection led to Snapdeal

From Snapdeal to Titan Capital and Shark Tank India

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

'No better time to come back to India'

An H-1B visa rejection in 2007 changed the course of entrepreneur Kunal Bahl's career. He was working at Microsoft in the United States and was asked to relocate to the company's India office after his work visa petition was rejected. Instead of waiting another year to reapply, Bahl decided to return to India and build his own business. Nearly two decades later, Bahl is the co-founder of e-commerce platform Snapdeal and investment firm Titan Capital. He is also a judge on Shark Tank India and has helped build two publicly listed companies.Recalling the experience in an interview with Business Insider , Bahl said the visa rejection was a blessing in disguise."Entrepreneurship was always on the cards for me. An H-1B rejection just fast-tracked it," he said.Bahl had graduated from the University of Pennsylvania, where he pursued a programme combining engineering and business. He joined Microsoft as a full-time employee in October 2006 after completing an internship with the company. But as fate would have it, his H-1B petition was rejected in June or July 2007, when he was approaching the end of his temporary work authorisation in the US.The decision came as a surprise to him, particularly because he was employed by one of the world's biggest technology companies. Microsoft offered him the option of relocating to its India office and trying for an H-1B visa again after 12 months.But Bahl decided against continuing his corporate career in India while waiting for another visa opportunity."I no longer had the baggage of having to figure out this H-1B situation. I felt liberated because I didn't have to worry about visas or Green Cards," he recalled. By that time, he had already been thinking about entrepreneurship and decided that if he returned to India, he would work for himself rather than continue working for Microsoft.Bahl contacted his high-school friend Rohit Bansal, who was then working at a financial institution, and asked whether he wanted to start a business together. The two had discussed entrepreneurship while studying together and quickly agreed to pursue the idea.Their company was incorporated on September 12, 2007, a few days before Bahl arrived in India.The founders pooled approximately $60,000 from their personal savings to get the business started. They initially launched a physical coupon-book business before moving to online couponing and eventually building Snapdeal into one of India's early e-commerce platforms.Bahl said starting a company in India in 2007 was challenging. Internet penetration and smartphone adoption were limited, digital payments were not widespread, and raising money from angel investors was difficult.The two entrepreneurs initially worked out of a small office in the basement of a residential building in Delhi's furniture market. They also stayed with their families to save on accommodation and food expenses.Their business eventually grew into Snapdeal, which became a major name in India's online shopping market.Bahl and Bansal expanded their entrepreneurial journey into startup investing in 2011 by establishing Titan Capital.Over the past 15 years, the investment firm has backed more than 320 startups, according to Bahl's Business Insider interview. Its investments include companies such as Ola and Urban Company.The founders also went on to build businesses that eventually became two publicly listed companies.Bahl is now associated with AceVector, the parent company of Snapdeal, Unicommerce and Stellaro Brands. He is also a judge on Shark Tank India, where entrepreneurs pitch their businesses to investors.Looking back, Bahl described his H-1B rejection as a fortunate turning point, although he acknowledged that the experience was painful at the time. "In hindsight, my not getting the H-1B visa was serendipitous," he said, adding that it became part of a larger journey that brought him back to India to help build the country's startup ecosystem. But he admitted that returning to India is not an equally easy decision for everyone facing immigration difficulties in the US. It was easier for him to pack his bags and leave as he was unmarried.India now has widespread internet and smartphone access, a larger pool of skilled professionals, more coworking spaces, a stronger funding ecosystem and greater government support for startups. "There is no better time to come back," he said.
Article Summary: Kunal Bahl is the co-founder of e-commerce platform Snapdeal and investment firm Titan Capital. He is also a judge on Shark Tank India and has helped build two publicly listed companies. He was working at Microsoft in the United States when his H-1B visa was rejected. Instead of waiting another year to reapply, Bahl decided to return to India and build his own business.

Article Title: First since 2015: No 'severe' AQI days for Delhi during November 1-15
Article Text:
Delhi recorded no severe air quality days during its most polluted period from November 1 to 15.

The average Air Quality Index was lower this year compared to last year

TOI

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines





NEW DELHI: What is usually Delhi's most polluted fortnight, from Nov 1 to 15, has ended this year without a single severe air quality day for the first time. A severe day means an AQI above 400 on a scale up to 500.Data from the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), which began calculating the Air Quality Index (AQI) in April 2015, shows that Delhi recorded three severe days during this period in 2025, two in 2024, six in 2023, three in 2022, seven in 2021 and eight in 2020. The number of such days when AQI surpassed 400 was six in 2019, five in 2018, seven in 2017, nine in 2016 and three in 2015. The average AQI during this fortnight was 343 this year as compared to 367 last year and was the same as in 2022.Experts said better meteorological conditions, new stations recording lower readings, restrictions under the Graded Response Action Plan and Delhi's winter framework and low contribution of stubble burning likely prevented AQI from a further rise.On Diwali night, CPCB did not share the readings for several hours for many stations when the particulate matter concentrations surpassed 1,000 micrograms per cubic metre. This missing data was not considered for the calculation of the 24-hour average AQI.Also Read| 4 out of 5 vehicles sold in festive rush are two-wheelers, EV bikes yet to catch up Sunil Dahiya, founder of think tank Envirocatalyst, said Delhi didn’t record severe air pollution this Nov because weather conditions were favourable. “While wind direction helped around Diwali, it was the most stagnant start to Nov on record. Less stubble smoke reached the city this year than in the heavy-burning years. Part of the no ‘severe’ day headline is also arithmetic; the bigger monitoring network, with newer lower-reading stations, pulled the city average down. On the long-running stations alone, Delhi crossed into ‘severe’ on three days,” said Dahiya.Another expert said, “Many stations have been recording severe air quality in Nov. However, new monitoring stations have seen lower AQI which have affected the city average.” He added, “On Diwali night, particulate matter concentrations at many stations surpassed 1,000 micrograms per cubic metre which was not considered for the 24-hour average AQI.”reported that missing PM2.5 data could have pushed Delhi’s average pollution levels 49% higher on Diwali, according to an analysis by Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA). Had the missing readings been recorded at 1,000 micrograms per cubic metre, the city’s average PM2.5 level would have increased from 269 to 400 micrograms per cubic metre, it revealed.Nov 1-15 is typically the capital’s most polluted period, with the average AQI at 374. In the first fortnight of Nov this year, Delhi recorded three poor days (AQI between 201 and 300) and 12 very poor days (AQI between 301 and 400). The highest AQI was recorded at 382 on Nov 6. However, the AQI remained in the severe category for a few hours on the morning of Nov 13, but the favourable weather factors brought down the 24-hour average AQI to 373.However, experts emphasised that the worst is not over yet. The city usually records severe air quality in Dec and Jan. The analysis of CPCB data showed that the second most polluted fortnight in a year is from Dec 16 to 31 with an average AQI of 346. This fortnight witnesses low temperatures and dense fog which traps pollutants. It also records increased traffic and use of firecrackers due to wedding season, Christmas and New Year’s Eve.Last year, this period saw five severe days, including a severe-plus day when AQI touched 461.The third most polluted spell is typically from Jan 1 to 15 when the unfavourable meteorological conditions, including dense fog, low temperatures and calm winds, continue. The average AQI of the period from Jan 1 to 15 was 329.3 during the period from 2016 to 2026.Meanwhile, Delhi’s AQI was 275 in the poor range Monday. Sirifort was the lone station to witness severe air quality at 441. The air quality of Delhi is forecast to worsen to very poor Tuesday.Biomass burning, including stubble burning, domestic solid biofuel, dung cakes and wood, was the dominant source of pollution, accounting for 30.9% in Delhi’s PM2.5 between 1 am and 9 am Monday. It was followed by mixed combustion at 27%, secondary organic aerosols at 19.6% and secondary inorganic aerosols at 8.8%, according to the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology’s real-time source apportionment data. Emissions from vehicles and firecrackers contributed to around 7.5% and 5.8%, respectively.
Article Summary: Nov 1-15 is typically the capital’s most polluted period, with the average AQI at 374. In the first fortnight of Nov this year, Delhi recorded three poor days and 12 very poor days (AQI between 301 and 400) The highest AQI was recorded at 382 on Nov 6.

Article Title: Goregaon East property prices jump 51% and West rates rise 38% as redevelopment, Metro expansion and new road projects transform Mumbai suburb from residential pocket into mixed-use hub
Article Text:
Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines





MUMBAI: Once known primarily as a residential suburb, Goregaon is gradually acquiring a new identity. Better road and Metro connectivity, large-scale redevelopment and the growth of commercial centres are changing the way people live and work here. The suburb is increasingly emerging as a mix of residential neighbourhoods, business districts and retail destinations, say real estate experts.Redevelopment of housing societies has gathered pace in both Goregaon East and West, as a shortage of available land pushes the suburb towards urban renewal. Hundreds of societies, many housed in ageing buildings dating back to the 1960s and 1970s, are opting for redevelopment.Nikhil Bhatia, managing director and co-head of capital markets at CBRE India, said, "Large redevelopment initiatives, including MHADA's Motilal Nagar enclave, are reinforcing Goregaon's transformation."A major connectivity boost is expected from the 12.2-km Goregaon-Mulund Link Road (GMLR), which will connect the Western and Eastern Express Highways through twin tunnels beneath Sanjay Gandhi National Park.The project is expected to cut travel time between Goregaon and Mulund substantially. Another major project, the proposed Versova-Bhayander coastal road, is expected to improve north-south connectivity across the western suburbs, with a planned connector near Mindspace in Malad linking it to GMLR.Metro connectivity is expanding too. Operational Metro Line 2A connects Goregaon with Andheri, Malad, Kandivli and Dahisar. Upcoming Lines 2B and 6 are expected to improve access to BKC, Powai and the eastern suburbs, while extensions of Line 7 towards Mira-Bhayandar and the airport are planned. Together with Goregaon and Ram Mandir railway stations, these links are expected to strengthen the suburb's connectivity with different parts of Mumbai.Improved connectivity is also supporting the growth of commercial activity. Business districts and employment centres such as Mindspace, NESCO, Nirlon Knowledge Park and Film City, along with the Oshiwara Development Corridor, are helping create a mix of offices, homes, shopping and leisure destinations.Developers and property brokers say demand is being supported by connectivity, social infrastructure and proximity to employment centres. Gagan Mehta, director at AGM Vijaylaxmi Group, said, "Goregaon's appeal has widened beyond its traditional catchment areas. We are seeing interest from homebuyers in neighbouring areas such as Jogeshwari, Malad and Kandivali."Residential market data covering projects launched between Q1 2022 and Q3 2026 shows that property prices have risen substantially in both parts of Goregaon.In Goregaon East, the weighted average selling price rose from Rs 26,831 per sq ft of carpet area in 2022 to Rs 40,430 in 2026, an increase of around 51%. In Goregaon West, it went up from Rs 23,926 to Rs 32,944 during the same period, a rise of around 38%.Knight Frank's Gulam Zia said, "Goregaon's property market remained resilient even when east-west connectivity was largely limited to two flyovers and the Metro had only recently opened. Much of the planned infrastructure is still in the pipeline, but demand is likely to grow even without these projects."The two markets have also seen different patterns in new housing supply and sales. Goregaon East recorded 767 apartment launches in 2025, of which 348 had been absorbed. In Goregaon West, 1,323 apartments were launched and 899 were absorbed. In 2026, up to Q3, Goregaon East recorded 241 launches and 35 absorptions, while Goregaon West saw 1,333 launches and 424 absorptions.The figures point to a considerably larger supply pipeline in Goregaon West, where launches have also outpaced sales. In Goregaon East, the gap between launches and absorptions widened in the first nine months of 2026. Absorption refers to cumulative sales from homes launched in the respective year, as recorded in the dataset.Ram Naik, co-founder and CEO of The Guardians Real Estate Advisory, said, "Goregaon's growth is becoming increasingly differentiated across its micro-markets. The east is emerging as a stronger commercial and employment destination, while the west continues to benefit from established residential demand, retail infrastructure and redevelopment."However, the pace of redevelopment and rising population density have also raised concerns. "Construction in Goregaon has gone unchecked. There are serious questions about whether the city's urban environment can absorb further high-density development.Developers wield excessive influence, and there are insufficient checks on the construction of tall buildings," said activist Zoru Bathena.Redevelopment can help replace Goregaon's ageing housing stock, but higher population density can put considerable pressure on drainage, roads, open spaces and public amenities, said activist Anil Galgali. "Rising property prices could also make homeownership increasingly difficult for some buyers." A Mhada official said the scale of transformation requires coordinated planning. "Cluster redevelopment can integrate amenities and infrastructure more effectively than individual projects. "
Article Summary: Goregaon is increasingly emerging as a mix of residential neighbourhoods, business districts and retail destinations. Redevelopment of housing societies has gathered pace in both Goregaon East and West. Developers and property brokers say demand is being supported by connectivity, social infrastructure and proximity to employment centres.

Article Title: No wildlife board nod, stop-work order issued to Adani company’s power project in Satara
Article Text:
Adani Renewable Energy One Ltd has received a stop-work order for the Tarali pumped storage project in Maharashtra.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Poll Vote & Share your view What should be the top priority when developing large infrastructure projects? Environmental protection Economic development Public welfare Sustainable growth 3k+ users shared opinion today 5k+ users already voted today 3k+ users shared opinion today Share Opinion





MUMBAI: The deputy conservator of forests (DCF), Satara forest division, has issued a stop-work order to the project manager of Adani Renewable Energy One Ltd, Mumbai, for starting work on the 1,500MW Tarali pumped storage project in the district’s Patan taluka without prior approval from National Board for Wildlife (NBWL).Adani Group said the proposal for wildlife clearance has been submitted to the board.The action by DCF Amol Satpute came after it was separately flagged in Oct that Adani Green Energy Ltd (AGEL), which is executing the project, had understated the project cost to the state govt, slashing it from Rs 5,675 crore to Rs 56.75 crore, to reduce its statutory environmental obligations.Issuing a show-cause notice on Nov 13 under Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, and Maharashtra Tree Felling (Regulation) Act, 1964, the DCF sought a written explanation on the authority under which the project was initiated without the valid NBWL permission. He warned that if work continues at the site, strict legal and penal action would be initiated under the applicable forest laws.The notice asks whether permissions were obtained from the competent authorities for tree felling linked to the project. The company has been asked to submit the total number of trees approved for felling if such permissions exist, along with original or attested permits, and provide all related statutory approvals and project maps within the stipulated period.The reply was to be submitted to the range forest officer’s office within three days of receipt of the notice.An AGEL spokesperson said the necessary permissions/NOCs on land use and statutory requirements had been obtained from the competent authorities. The spokesperson said based on the environmental clearance granted in Feb 2025, Maharashtra Pollution Control Board issued the consent to establish on April 7, 2025 to allow the work to begin. “Construction activities commenced only after obtaining all the requisite approvals from the authorities concerned. ”The company said the process for wildlife clearance has been duly initiated and pursued as part of the environmental clearance compliance process. “The proposal for survey and investigation activities was submitted in Jan 2025 and subsequently recommended by the state board for wildlife. The proposal for the project has since been submitted to NBWL and is currently under consideration. The project is being developed in full compliance with applicable statutory requirements and the directions of the competent authorities. ”The spokesperson said no project component falls in any notified protected area or forest land, and that the NOC stating this was received on Jan 23, 2024.On Oct 30, Satara’s honorary wildlife warden Rohan Bhate had flagged an alleged discrepancy in the project cost declared to the state govt, stating it was shown as Rs 56.75 crore instead of Rs 5,675 crore. In representations to NBWL, the ministry of environment, forest and climate change (MoEFCC) and the CM, he sought an independent inquiry, arguing that an understated cost could amount to misrepresentation and could affect wildlife conservation contributions linked to the project value.MoEFCC’s environmental clearance issued on Feb 11, 2025, records the project cost at Rs 5,675 crore. It also lists Rs 39.3 crore as capital cost for the environment management plan and pollution control measures, and Rs 27.5 crore as recurring operation and maintenance cost.Reports also state that on Sept 7, AGEL chief operating officer Naresh Telugu submitted a letter to the principal chief conservator of forests (wildlife), Maharashtra, along with a notarised undertaking on a Rs 500-stamp paper, citing the project cost as Rs 56.75 crore. The undertaking reportedly said the figure was based on an “analogous estimation” used while submitting “Part IV,” requested authorities to consider Rs 56.75 crore as the project cost, and committed to mitigation and conservation measures.The company denied allegations of cost understatement to reduce statutory obligations, saying figures mentioned in the online forest and wildlife clearance proposal related only to preliminary investigations and surveys.In his letters, Bhate had said, “The difference between the estimated total project cost reflected in the available project documents and the amount stated in the notarised undertaking by AGEL is substantial. The two figures differ by a factor of 100. The administration of Sahyadri tiger reserve (STR) had communicated to AGEL well in advance that an amount equivalent to 4% of the total project cost, ie, approximately Rs 227 crore, was required to be deposited in the account of the STR Conservation Foundation for wildlife conservation and protection, subject to the applicable provisions and conditions.” He said based on the revised project cost of Rs 56.75 crore, an amount equivalent to 1% was calculated as Rs 56.75 lakh for payment. The remaining 3% was to be paid after NBWL’s clearance.“If the project cost has indeed been deliberately understated in the undertaking submitted to the state govt, the matter raises serious concerns regarding the possible misrepresentation of material financial information to govt and its consequential impact on the financial contribution required for wildlife conservation. Hence, it has been necessary to establish whether the project cost was correctly assessed, whether the applicable contribution requirements were properly implemented, and whether the decision to calculate the contribution on the basis of Rs 56.75 crore as revised project cost was supported by the relevant rules, official records and approved conditions,” Bhate had said.
Article Summary: Adani Renewable Energy One Ltd has received a stop-work order for the Tarali pumped storage project in Maharashtra. The company has been asked to submit the total number of trees approved for felling if such permissions exist, along with original or attested permits.

Article Title: Tata group stocks rally up to 9% after RBI nudges Tata Sons to comply with listing norms
Article Text:
A possible listing of Tata Sons could also give the Shapoorji Pallonji Group an opportunity to unlock the value of its approximately 18% stake in the company.

Tata Group shares rally

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Will Tata Sons list?

(Disclaimer: Recommendations and views on the stock market, or any other asset classes or personal finance management tips given by experts and analysts are their own. These opinions do not represent the views of The Times of India.)

With the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) refusing to grant exception to the listing of Tata Sons , shares of the group’s companies rallied on Tuesday. Shares of several Tata Group companies climbed on Tuesday after RBI directed Tata Sons to adhere to all applicable regulations for upper-layer non-banking financial companies (NBFCs).These include the requirement for the holding company of the salt-to-software conglomerate to list its shares.Tata Sons has been classified as an upper-layer non-banking financial company (NBFC) since 2022. In July 2025, Tata Trusts, which exercises control over 66% of the holding company through the Sir Ratan Tata Trust and the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust, passed a resolution favouring the continuation of Tata Sons as a privately held entity.Tata Chemicals surged 9%, while Tata Investment Corporation advanced more than 3%. Shares of Tata Motors and Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles rose around 2% each.Tata Chemicals owns a 2.53% stake in Tata Sons, valued at Rs 30,052.2 crore. Tata Investment Corporation's shareholding in the holding company is worth more than Rs 950 crore. Given these substantial investments, shares of both companies are particularly exposed to developments concerning the proposed Tata Sons IPO.Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles and Tata Steel each own slightly more than 3% of Tata Sons, with their respective holdings valued at around Rs 36,348 crore. Tata Power and The Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) have stakes ranging between 1% and 2%.The gains followed the emergence of a letter from the central bank to Tata Sons' chief financial officer, intensifying pressure on the holding company to go ahead with its long-awaited initial public offering (IPO), which it has resisted for years, according to an ET report.“While specific guidance has not been sought on any particular regulation/ guideline/ direction, from the discussion in the board regarding listing, it seems the guidance is perhaps with respect to the same,” RBI said in its letter.“You are advised to comply with all applicable regulations/ guidelines/ directions, issued by RBI in respect of NBFCs in the upper layer (NBFC-UL), as stipulated in extant regulations/ guidelines/ directions hosted on the RBI's website, including the requirement of listing by your company,” the central bank added in the letter dated November 16.Earlier, in September this year, RBI turned down Tata Sons' application to voluntarily surrender its Certificate of Registration (CoR) and move to the category of an unregistered Core Investment Company (CIC). The rejection cleared the way for a potential public listing of the holding company of India's largest business conglomerate, whose operations span multiple sectors and countries.A possible listing of Tata Sons could also give the Shapoorji Pallonji Group an opportunity to unlock the value of its approximately 18% stake in the company. The debt-laden group has been exploring ways to monetise a portion of this holding to repay part of its estimated Rs 60,000 crore debt.
Article Summary: Tata Chemicals surged 9%, while Tata Investment Corporation advanced more than 3%. Shares of Tata Motors and Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles rose around 2% each. A possible listing of Tata Sons could also give the Shapoorji Pallonji Group an opportunity to unlock the value of its approximately 18% stake in the company.

Article Title: Oil prices fall as surplus fears return after a nine-month dry spell in the market
Article Text:
Crude prices fall amid fears of supply surplus

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Oil prices fell on Monday as concerns over a potential supply surplus weighed on the market, with shipments through the Strait of Hormuz recovering to nearly pre-war levels after months of disruption. The US has also eased restrictions on transporting fuel between its ports, adding to expectations of higher supply.WTI crude futures were trading at $88.35, down 21 cents or 0.24%, while Brent crude futures stood at $95.40, lower by 44 cents or 0.46%.The market is increasingly factoring in the possibility that available supplies could exceed demand in the coming months. The International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Friday that the global oil market is expected to move into a surplus in the fourth quarter of this year, reversing its earlier forecast of a supply deficit.According to the agency, average oil supply during the quarter could reach 105 million barrels per day, exceeding projected demand by 1.7 million barrels per day. The recovery in Middle East exports is expected to outpace growth in global demand, even as attacks on shipping continue."For the first time since the US-Iran conflict began, traders are actively contemplating the possibility of excess supply rather than persistent tightness.That shift in narrative is clearly dampening the tone," said Tim Waterer, chief analyst at KCM Trade.The IEA also said 71 million barrels from the record release of emergency oil reserves pledged by its members in March would be made available by the end of February. This includes 15 million barrels of diesel intended to ease tightness in the market.The downward movement in prices comes after both major benchmarks had already recorded steep weekly losses. Oil settled lower on Friday as traders assessed signs of reduced geopolitical risks from the US-Israeli war against Iran, now in its ninth month. WTI and Brent had shed 16% and 13%, respectively, over the previous week.Another factor weighing on crude prices is the US decision to extend the suspension of restrictions under the Jones Act for another 90 days.US President Donald Trump extended the waiver, a White House official said on Friday. The law normally requires cargo moved between US ports to be carried by US-flagged vessels. Its suspension allows foreign-flagged ships to transport oil and fuels, including petrol and diesel, between domestic ports, expanding the pool of available tankers.However, the easing of supply concerns does not mean lower shipping costs. Waterer said that elevated freight rates were continuing to support oil prices.The cost of transporting crude remains high because tankers face risks while passing through the Strait of Hormuz. Vessel availability has also been affected by ships being tied up in transporting oil through the waterway, where cargoes are transferred to other vessels for onward delivery to refineries.The risks to shipping were highlighted again on Sunday night, when Iran's navy said an oil tanker had caught fire after hitting a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz, according to state media.
Article Summary: WTI crude futures were trading at $88.35, down 21 cents or 0.24%, while Brent crude futures stood at $95.40, lower by 44 cents or0.46%. The market is increasingly factoring in the possibility that available supplies could exceed demand in the coming months.

Article Title: Indian bonds brace for a rough week as US treasury selloff sends yields soaring
Article Text:
Indian bond selloff to persist after treasuries see worst week in seven months

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Indian government bonds could face fresh pressure at the start of the week, with rising US Treasury yields and a spike in domestic retail inflation weighing on market sentiment. The sharp selloff in US government debt last week pushed its 10-year yield up nearly 30 basis points, as investors factored in the possibility of a bigger Federal Reserve rate hike.The yield on India's benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond is likely to trade between 7.29% and 7.35% on Monday, a private-bank trader told Reuters. The bond had settled at 7.3079% on Friday.The US 10-year treasury yield closed Friday at around 5.15%, marking a 29-basis-point increase over the week. This was its steepest weekly rise in seven months and came amid growing concerns that the Federal Reserve could announce a larger-than-usual rate hike.The upward movement in US yields followed stronger-than-expected consumer price data for October and hawkish comments from some Federal Reserve members. These developments prompted markets to raise their bets on a bigger rate increase at the Fed's December 9 meeting.Traders are now assigning a 6% probability to a 50-basis-point hike on December 9, according to the CME FedWatch tool.The rise in US yields has also affected domestic bond market sentiment. India's 10-year benchmark yield increased 12 basis points last week, reversing half of the decline recorded during the first week of November."Rising US yields are likely to weigh on sentiment in the local market, especially after the sharp move witnessed in the previous week. Traders will be cautious, and the 10-year bond yield could test fresh highs," the trader said.The domestic inflation numbers have added another concern for the bond market. India's retail inflation accelerated to 6.09% in October, compared with 5.54% in September, crossing the upper tolerance band of the Reserve Bank of India 's inflation target.According to STCI Primary Dealer, the latest inflation reading signals upward risks to food inflation, although fuel prices remain controlled for now.The increase in retail inflation has also strengthened expectations of another interest rate hike by the Reserve Bank of India in early December.
Article Summary: The yield on India's benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond is likely to trade between 7.29% and 7.35% on Monday. The US 10-year treasury yield closed Friday at around 5.15%, marking a 29-basis-point increase over the week.

Article Title: Rupee extends winning streak, breaks below 94 against dollar: What's next
Article Text:
Rupee moves below 94 against US dollar

Crude oil prices cool as hopes of peace grow

Foreign fund inflows add to rupee's support

NEW DELHI: Rupee extended its gains for a second straight session on Monday, moving below the 94-per-dollar mark. The rally was supported by softer crude oil prices, stronger foreign fund inflows and hopes of easing tensions in the Middle East.The currency rose 24 paise to 93.74 against the US dollar in early trade. It opened at around 93.85 in the interbank forex market before gaining further. Rupee had already made a strong recovery on Friday, rising 43 paise to close at 93.98 against the greenback.Forex traders said rupee could maintain its positive momentum if diplomatic efforts in the Middle East make progress. Any easing of tensions could reduce the risk premium in crude oil prices, providing further support to the currency.These hopes gained ground over the weekend after US President Donald Trump indicated that further military strikes against Iran were highly unlikely if negotiations progressed and both sides reached a strong agreement.The easing in crude oil prices has been one of the key factors supporting rupee. Brent crude, which had earlier climbed to around $117.64, has now slipped below $100 and is trading near $98. Amit Pabari, managing director of CR Forex Advisors, said improving diplomatic expectations were already having an impact on energy prices."The improvement in diplomatic expectations is already reflecting in energy prices. Brent crude, which had climbed to around $117.64, has now slipped below $100 and is trading near $98. For currency markets, even the possibility of a lasting agreement is important," Pabari said.Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, was trading 0.15% lower at $98.17 per barrel in futures trade. The dollar index, which measures the greenback's strength against a basket of six currencies, was also down 0.12% at 102.18.Foreign investment activity provided another source of support for the domestic currency. Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) purchased equities worth Rs 13,749.82 crore on Friday, according to exchange data.The combination of lower crude prices and stronger foreign fund inflows has supported the rupee's recent gains against the dollar.With rupee now below the 94-per-dollar level, Pabari sees further room for appreciation. He expects the currency to move towards 93.50 and 93.00, while identifying 94.40–94.50 as the immediate resistance zone."With USD/INR breaking below the 94.00 mark, the probability of further rupee appreciation towards 93.50 and 93.00 has increased. On the upside, 94.40–94.50 is likely to act as the immediate resistance zone," Pabari said.Meanwhile, domestic equity markets opened lower on Monday. BSE Sensex fell 93.95 points to 80,919.19, while NSE Nifty declined 30 points to 24,968.80.Separately, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) reported that India's foreign exchange reserves declined by $2.691 billion to $717.056 billion in the week ended October 30.
Article Summary: Rupee extended its gains for a second straight session on Monday, moving below the 94-per-dollar mark. The rally was supported by softer crude oil prices, stronger foreign fund inflows and hopes of easing tensions in the Middle East. Rupee had already made a strong recovery on Friday, rising 43 paise to close at 93.98.

Article Title: Sale of an oceanfront mansion in Golden Beach for record $69.5 million, has the town speculating about Jeff Bezos as the likely buyer after ...
Article Text:
Rumours point to Jeff Bezos

Record sale for Golden Beach

The house

Why buyers use LLCs

A second home near the first

A note of caution

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Jeff Bezos’ Florida portfolio

Amazon founder Jeff Bezos may have added a beach house to his $237 million Miami compound, though nothing has been confirmed. According to a public records search by Fortune, a Delaware LLC paid $69.5 million in September for a 17,500-square-foot oceanfront estate at 255 Ocean Boulevard in Golden Beach, an exclusive town in Miami-Dade County. Public records list the buyer as Meridian Coast LLC, a structure that keeps the person behind the purchase out of view. Agents and other sources in town have pointed to Bezos, The Real Deal reported, and say he would likely use the property as a beach house. Bezos has not publicly confirmed the deal, and his representatives did not immediately respond to Fortune’s request for comment.While the buyer has not been officially identified, local real estate agents and sources cited by The Real Deal have linked the purchase to Bezos. The report noted that the billionaire has not publicly confirmed any involvement in the transaction, and representatives for Bezos did not immediately respond to Fortune's request for comment.The property is located roughly a 30-minute drive from Bezos' existing real estate holdings in Indian Creek, the exclusive island community often referred to as the "Billionaire Bunker." Bezos already owns a sprawling Miami-area compound valued at about $237 million, according to Fortune.Industry experts noted that it is increasingly common for ultra-wealthy buyers to route purchases through LLCs and trusts to enhance privacy and security. Ken DeLeon, founder of DeLeon Realty, previously told Fortune that such structures help prevent ownership records from being directly tied to high-profile individuals.The transaction set a new record for a single-family home sale in Golden Beach, according to The Real Deal. The waterfront mansion features seven bedrooms, 12 bathrooms, a guesthouse, swimming pool, spa and approximately 100 feet of ocean frontage. Property records reviewed by Fortune show the home was initially listed in February for $88.5 million before the asking price was later reduced to $79.5 million. The final sale price of $69.5 million still established a benchmark for the affluent coastal enclave.The sale set a record for a single-family home in Golden Beach, according to The Real Deal. The house has seven bedrooms and 12 bathrooms, plus a guesthouse, a pool, a spa and 100 feet of water frontage. It came on the market in February at $88.5 million, and the price was later cut to $79.5 million, public records reviewed by Fortune show.Buying through LLCs and trusts has become more common among the ultrawealthy, who increasingly see public attention as a security risk. Ken DeLeon, founder of DeLeon Realty in Palo Alto, told Fortune earlier this year that the aim is to make sure even someone digging through ownership records cannot easily link a property to the person behind it.The Golden Beach house is only about a 30-minute drive from Bezos’ compound in Indian Creek, known as the “Billionaire Bunker,” a 300-acre man-made strip of land that has drawn many of the ultrawealthy. Mendel Fellig of the Mendel Fellig Group at Compass told Fortune that, at Bezos’ level, owning another home nearby isn’t redundant. A buyer with an excellent waterfront home may still want direct access to a private stretch of beach, he said, and Golden Beach is one of the few places in Miami that offers that, making the second property “almost an amenity in itself. ” He added that assembling a portfolio gives such buyers different residential experiences while securing properties that are increasingly hard to replace.Not everyone is convinced. Devin Kay of Douglas Elliman told Fox Business that recognisable names tend to get attached to blockbuster deals when a buyer’s identity is hidden. He said South Florida’s pool of billionaire buyers has expanded considerably, with international business owners, hedge fund executives, technology founders and multigenerational families quietly buying some of the region’s most valuable property.If Bezos is the buyer, the house would join a portfolio he began building after leaving Seattle for Miami in 2023. He said then that he wanted to be closer to his parents and to Blue Origin’s operations at Cape Canaveral. The move has also paid off at tax time. Florida has no state income or capital gains tax, and Fortune previously reported, citing a Forbes calculation, that Bezos saved an estimated $1 billion in 2024 alone, compared with about $954 million in Washington State capital gains tax he would have owed on his Amazon stock sales that year.
Article Summary: A Delaware LLC paid $69.5 million in September for a 17,500-square-foot oceanfront estate in Golden Beach, an exclusive town in Miami-Dade County. Public records list the buyer as Meridian Coast LLC, a structure that keeps the person behind the purchase out of view. Agents and other sources in town have pointed to Bezos, and say he would likely use the property as a beach house. Bezos has not publicly confirmed the deal, and his representatives did not immediately respond to Fortune’s request for comment.

We’re working on them. Please try back later.”The problems follow major outages last week, when a Microsoft email outage disrupted businesses. Article Title: FBI warns companies in the US and across the world; names AI hacking tool criminals are using to attack financial services; suggests dos and don'ts
Article Text:
FBI recommends organizations take the steps below to improve their security posture:

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Hackers are increasingly deploying autonomous artificial intelligence tools to execute high-speed cyberattacks across the United States and around the globe, according to a flash cybersecurity advisory issued by the Federal Bureau of Investigation. The warning highlights a wave of recent intrusions targeting major sectors—including government, defense, telecommunications, law, technology, and finance—with major fallout already documented across South Korea’s financial industry and among thousands of customers of American IT firm ConnectWise.At the center of the FBI’s alert is Artex, an open-source, AI-powered penetration testing platform originally designed to probe network defenses. By linking Artex to frontier large language models from companies like OpenAI and Anthropic, as well as open-source and foreign AI models, threat actors have been able to automate the discovery and exploitation of basic security flaws. "Since at least August 2026, a variety of malicious cyber actors have used Artex to conduct campaigns targeting organizations globally across multiple sectors, including financial services, government, technology, defense, semiconductor, energy, healthcare, manufacturing, telecommunications, and legal industries," said FBI in its report.While federal officials noted that Artex-driven intrusions are often "noisy"—generating high volumes of network traffic that can set off security alarms—the software operates at a pace that routinely outstrips human response times. In several observed cases, attackers progressed from initial targeting to full system compromise in under three hours.Once aimed at a target, the software rapidly scans networks for low-hanging vulnerabilities, such as weak configurations, missing multi-factor authentication, or exposed passwords. Upon securing a foothold, the tool autonomously navigates internal systems to harvest sensitive databases, mailboxes, and credentials.Since Artex debuted publicly in July, its capabilities have been tied to several high-profile breaches. In South Korea, attackers leveraged the platform against multiple financial institutions lacking basic protections like multi-factor authentication, resulting in the theft of personal records belonging to at least 68,000 individuals. "As of early November 2026, researchers identified over 1,600 publicly exposed ARTEX console instances, with total deployments likely significantly higher when including systems behind firewalls or in private networks," says FBI.The FBI also corroborated earlier intelligence from Microsoft detailing how threat actors—believed by Microsoft to be operating out of China—used Artex to infiltrate IT management provider ConnectWise. Through that breach, the hackers accessed the Microsoft 365 cloud environments of at least 2,250 ConnectWise customers to exfiltrate data.Although the creator of Artex has since transitioned the software to a closed-source model in an effort to curb abuse, the FBI cautioned that earlier open-source versions remain widely circulated and easily accessible online. Compounding the threat, careless operational security by the hackers themselves has left hundreds of active Artex instances exposed on the public internet without password protection. Just last week, cybersecurity researchers discovered numerous unprotected deployments online—including the exact system used to orchestrate the attacks against South Korea—potentially leaving powerful, turnkey hacking infrastructure open to anyone who stumbles across it.• Restrict cloud administration, network device management, application publishing interfaces (Kudu/SCM endpoints), hypervisors, backup platforms, and other sensitive services to trusted networks,private connectivity, or dedicated administrative paths.• Disable basic publishing authentication where not required; restrict access to deployment and publishing credentials; restrict SCM access to approved management networks or deployment infrastructure.• Consider deployment models such as run-from-package that reduce direct modification of deployedapplication files.• Establish governance around public IP allocation; require architecture review before workloads or management interfaces are exposed directly to the internet.• Move enterprise applications behind Zero Trust access solutions to eliminate external exposure where feasible.* Put guardrails around high-impact business APIs: rate limits, recipient limits, transaction thresholds, abuse controls appropriate to function; alert when application operates materially outside normal volume.* On partner and employee portals, alert on sequential lookups and unusually high numbers of records accessed per session; apply rate limits to affected endpoints; enforce server-side authorization for access to customer records and limit responses to fields required for the operation.
Article Summary: Hackers are increasingly deploying autonomous artificial intelligence tools to execute high-speed cyberattacks across the U.S. and around the globe. The warning highlights a wave of recent intrusions targeting major sectors. At the center of the alert is Artex, an open-source, AI-powered penetration testing platform.

Article Title: US government proposes new rules for Green Cards; tells companies: American Workers are the best in the world, rule change will ensure they are …
Article Text:
US government proposes new rules for Green Cards; tells companies: American Workers are the best in the world

What changes are being proposed to Green Card rules

Companies that laid off US workers could face restrictions

Nurses and physical therapists could also face new requirements

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

When will the proposed Green Card rules take effect

The US government is proposing stricter rules for companies sponsoring foreign workers for employment-based Green Cards. The US Department of Labor says the changes will ensure that qualified American workers get the first opportunity to apply for high-skilled, high-paying jobs before companies turn to foreign workers. “American Workers are the best in the world, and they deserve the first and best job opportunities,” Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling said while announcing the proposal. He added that the rule change would put American workers “first in line” for such jobs.The proposal seeks to overhaul the Permanent Labor Certification programme, also known as PERM. It is the first major update to the programme in nearly 20 years.For the unaware, PERM is an important step for many employment-based Green Card applications under the EB-2 and EB-3 categories. Before sponsoring a foreign worker for permanent employment, companies generally have to show that they could not find qualified US workers for the position and that hiring the foreign worker would not adversely affect the wages and working conditions of American workers. PERM approval itself does not grant a Green Card.One of the biggest changes involves how companies advertise jobs. The Labor Department wants employers to move away from print-based advertisements and use modern recruitment methods. Under the proposal, companies would have to advertise vacancies through their websites, online job portals and social media platforms. They may also use job fairs and campus recruitment.Employers would have to keep job advertisements open for at least 90 calendar days. If they normally advertise similar positions for a longer period, they would have to follow that longer period. The department says this would give qualified American workers more time to learn about vacancies and apply.The proposal would also require companies to use the same recruitment channels and methods for PERM positions that they use for similar jobs that do not require labour certification. Employers would have to make genuine efforts to consider qualified US applicants and provide job-related reasons if they reject them.The proposed rules also target companies that lay off American employees while seeking to sponsor foreign workers. Under the proposal, employers would be barred from filing a PERM application if they had laid off US workers in the same or a similar occupation at the relevant work location during the previous two years.If a company lays off American workers after filing a PERM application, it would have to consider potentially qualified laid-off employees for the position. This requirement could continue until the related Form I-140 immigrant petition is approved or the case reaches a final decision.Employers would also have to inform the Labor Department, and the US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) where applicable, about such layoffs within five business days.The Labor Department has proposed ending the administrative exemptions under a system known as Schedule A. At present, certain occupations, including professional nurses and physical therapists, can bypass the usual labour market test under Schedule A. The exemption also covers certain individuals with exceptional ability in the sciences, arts and performing arts.If the proposal is adopted, employers seeking to sponsor foreign workers in these categories would also have to test the US labour market and consider qualified American applicants.The changes are not final yet. The Labor Department has invited the public to submit comments on the proposal for 60 days after its publication in the Federal Register on November 17.The proposal is part of the US administration's wider efforts to tighten employer-sponsored immigration pathways and strengthen protections for American workers. If finalised, the changes could make the PERM process more demanding for companies seeking to sponsor foreign employees for permanent residency in the US.
Article Summary: US Department of Labor says the changes will ensure that qualified American workers get the first opportunity to apply for high-skilled, high-paying jobs. The proposal seeks to overhaul the Permanent Labor Certification programme, also known as PERM. It is the first major update to the programme in nearly 20 years.

Article Title: Customers of Bank of America, Chase, JP Morgan, Wells Fargo and Zelle report issues accessing accounts online
Article Text:
JPMorgan Chase is among the affected banks (Reuters)

Banking disruptions follow major Microsoft global outage

Customers across several of the largest banks in US ran into trouble trying to access their accounts online on Monday (November 17). According to outage tracking website Downdetector.com, users reported that services were down or experiencing issues across multiple major financial institutions and payment platforms, including Bank of America, Chase, JP Morgan, US Bank, Wells Fargo and Zelle. As per a report by AP, some Chase users trying to log in were met with an error notice stating: “Some services aren’t available. We’re working on them. Please try back later.”At the time of publishing, Bank of America customers have registered about 2100 reports while consumer banking company Chase has nearly 5000 reports of issues ranging from Account balances and transactions, web login, and transfers and wires, as per downdetector. Chase Bank’s services are experiencing a technical bug issue, not a cyber issue, AP cited a spokesperson as saying.“Due to a technical issue, some transactions are taking longer than usual to complete but customers still have access to their accounts and funds. We are working to resolve this as quickly as possible,” the Chase spokesperson said.The online banking problems come on the heels of a major Microsoft outage last week that disrupted widely used services, including Outlook, Teams, and AI assistant Copilot, for hours.Microsoft has since apologised for the global disruption to its Microsoft 365 services, which took place on Thursday, November 12, 2026, and continued into Friday.Charles Lamanna, Microsoft’s executive vice president of Copilot, Agents and Platform, shared a Preliminary Post-Incident Report explaining what went wrong. According to Lamanna, three primary issues converged to knock offline the networking gateway that sits in front of many Microsoft 365 services.“More details on the root cause can be found in the Microsoft 365 Admin center, and an abridged version can be found below. We are deeply sorry for the impact to all our customers and recognize the impact that this has on their normal business & operations,” Lamanna said.As per the executive, the higher load and the lower server capacity together caused the gateway to hit the latent bug from July. Requests built up until the servers stopped responding. This happened during the peak window of traffic in the US.He explained that the recovery of services took longer because servers that came back into service were immediately overwhelmed by waiting traffic and stopped responding again.
Article Summary: Customers across several of the largest banks in US ran into trouble trying to access their accounts online on Monday (November 17) According to outage tracking website Downdetector.com, users reported that services were down or experiencing issues across multiple major financial institutions and payment platforms.

A large-scale cyberattack exposed visitors to some of the world's most-visited websites to malware after attackers compromised the Optimizely Web experimentation platform, according to security researchers at Report URI. The campaign affected 178 organisations and used trusted website infrastructure to deliver malicious code to unsuspecting users. Researchers said the attackers injected malicious JavaScript into Optimizely customer projects, allowing malware to be served through websites that users would normally consider trustworthy. Because the malicious code was delivered through Optimizely's own content delivery network and security certificates, the attack was difficult to detect.Report URI researcher Scott Helme said the attackers wrote malicious code into customer projects on Optimizely Web, a platform many large companies use to run website experiments. Those sites load a script from Optimizely’s servers, so the malware arrived from a source they already trusted, without their own systems being breached. Helme said it is not known how the attacker gained access to so many unrelated accounts.The malware was designed to perform multiple malicious activities, including stealing cryptocurrency, capturing payment card details, collecting cookies and taking screenshots. For users visiting affected websites on Apple devices, the attackers also deployed the Coruna and DarkSword iOS exploit kits in an apparent attempt to compromise iPhones and iPads. Report URI said cryptocurrency had already been stolen during the campaign, with verified transactions traced to wallets controlled by the attackers.The script swapped cryptocurrency wallet addresses for the attacker’s, skimmed card details typed into sites’ own payment forms, and sent back cookies and page screenshots. On iPhones and iPads, it loaded two exploit kits, Coruna and DarkSword, that target older iOS versions. Report URI said iOS 18.7.3 and later, and iOS 26.3 and later, are patched. By 19:25 UTC on Monday, the attacker’s wallets had received about $7,040.Report URI said remediation efforts appeared to be successful, with most of the malicious code removed by the time researchers completed their analysis. The number of infected snippets detected later in the day had fallen sharply compared with earlier findings. The incident highlights the growing risk posed by software supply-chain attacks, where hackers compromise third-party services used by multiple organisations, allowing them to reach large numbers of users without directly attacking each company individually.Most of the malicious code was removed by Monday evening. At 21:52 UTC only TalkTalk’s script was still infected, Report URI said. The firm advised anyone who visited an affected site on Monday to update their iPhone or iPad, check that any crypto transfer went to the intended address, and watch card statements.
